_title: Hotels Pay 30% to Book Their Own Rooms
_note: EP006, 2026-08-14. Booking.com is the first genuinely household-name incumbent the channel has had -- Accenture was B2B-famous, this is consumer-famous, so the 25-point recognisable dimension finally fires properly. Wordmark is NOT in Simple Icons; fetched from Wikimedia as a wordmark, since the EP001 lesson is that a bare glyph reads as nothing. Ground regenerated once: the first batch obeyed `object` loosely and returned an environmental shot where the key was ~18px at browse width. Words are job-framed per A9 -- `NOT YOUR GUEST` was equally legible and was dropped because the branded key ALREADY says the OTA owns the guest, so the overlay would have restated the image.
